functions.name: SupportsFramePace
functions.docs: Returns whether the hardware is able to frame pace at the specified frame rate

functions.name: GetFramePaceFromSyncInterval
functions.docs: The generic implementation returns a result based on rhi.SyncInterval and FPlatformMisc::GetMaxRefreshRate().

functions.name: SetFramePaceToSyncInterval

@return the pace we will run at.
